title: Manuj Lal — 'trust in data privacy and AI governance is not merely a soft concept; it is integral to building durable enterprise value'
summary: Manuj Lal, Privacy and Digital Governance Market Leader at PwC, posts a substantive LinkedIn endorsement reading Incorruptible through the lens of privacy, AI governance, and corporate responsibility — and tells privacy/trust officers their work is integral to durable enterprise value.
blockquote:
I recently finished reading "Incorruptible" by Eric Ries, and it resonated with me deeply, especially for those of us in privacy, AI governance, ethics, and corporate responsibility. There are days when it feels like financial gravity is overwhelming, and I understand that feeling from my own experiences in those rooms.

I've long been a student of stakeholder theory because corporate governance is not a zero-sum game. When executed effectively, it fosters mutual benefits for customers, employees, communities, and the business itself. I witness numerous examples of this with my clients daily. Today's privacy and trust officers recognize that trust in data privacy and AI governance is not merely a soft concept; it is integral to building durable enterprise value.
attribution_title: Privacy and Digital Governance Market Leader, PwC
